card.fact_statement: The New York City Police Department investigated the 2025 Tesla vandalism as a hate crime.
card.source_span: The New York City Police Department said they were investigating the vandalism as a hate crime.

target_qa_variants.question: หน่วยงานใดสืบสวนการทำลายทรัพย์สินรถเทสลาในปี 2025 ในฐานะอาชญากรรมจากความเกลียดชัง
target_qa_variants.expected_answer: กรมตำรวจนครนิวยอร์ก
target_qa_variants.source_span: The New York City Police Department said they were investigating the vandalism as a hate crime.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'organization' to 'หน่วยงาน' (agency/department) as it fits better with police departments in Thai context. 'New York City Police Department' is translated to 'กรมตำรวจนครนิวยอร์ก'.

backtranslation_en.question: Which agency investigated the vandalism of Tesla cars in 2025 as a hate crime?
